votes.motion: Endorse the ANR Plan for 238 Fire Road 16 (J&A Realty Trust); K. Chenis recused himself.
votes.quote: by endorsing this anr plan, the board has determined vital access. motion, d. mcquaid, second, d. prokowiew, to endorse the anr plan, all aye.

votes.motion: Endorse the ANR Plan for 331 Burrage Street (Daniel Proctor).
votes.quote: the lot cannot be a grandfathered lot. motion, d. mcquaid, second, d. prokowiew, to endorse the anr plan, all aye.

votes.motion: Endorse the ANR Plan for 200 Reservoir Road (Estate of Vera Barney), dividing the property into five lots.
votes.quote: dividing the property into five lots . motion, d. mcquaid, second, d. prokowiew, to endorse the anr plan, all aye.

votes.motion: Endorse the ANR Plan for 1026 & 1042 Northfield Road (Ronald Smith, Lucy Hawkins, Steven Anderson), creating a five-lot subdivision.
votes.quote: motion, k. chenis, second, d. prokowiew, to endorse the anr plan, all aye.

votes.motion: That the Board support the zoning warrant articles regarding the Whalom Overlay District for the 8/22/16 Special Town Meeting (one blanket vote for all Whalom articles).
votes.quote: motion, d. mcquaid, that the board support the warrant article s regarding the whalom overlay district, second, d. prokowiew, all aye.

votes.motion: To sign the minutes of June 27, 2016.
votes.quote: motion, d. mcquaid, to sign minutes of june 27, 2016, second, g. bittner, all aye. (k. chenis abstained.)

votes.motion: For M. Allison to be the Board's representative to the Town Manager Search Committee (roll call vote).
votes.quote: roll call vote for m. allison - d. prokowiew, aye; k. chenis, aye; g. bittner, aye; d. mcquaid, nay; m. allison, aye. vote passed 4 -1.

votes.motion: To send a letter to the ZBA noting that the applicant at 8 Massachusetts Avenue is operating without Planning Board approval.
votes.quote: motion, d. p rokowiew, to send a letter to the zba noting that the applicant is operating without planning board approval, second, g. bittner, all aye.
